Round 12 passes. All four acceptance checks hold up when I rerun them myself, I found no bugs, and real-app verification ran (`realVerified=true`). Root can publish rounds 11 and 12 together after its own verify and review.

- **R12-1 (docs edit): PASS.** The only change since `35ed18b` under `.claude/` is the `### Save flow` block in `STATE_MANAGEMENT.md`: two lines added, one removed. It is byte-identical to `a-round-11/state-management.patch`, and it matches what `MetadataPanel.tsx` does: edits are cleared only when no file failed to save.
- **R12-2 (nothing else changed): PASS.** HEAD is `35ed18b`. The tree shows exactly three modified files plus the one new test. Nothing else differs from `35ed18b`, including `.claude/primitives-map.json` and `.claude/settings*.json`. The three round-11 files still have the hashes from `c-round-11/end-hash.txt`, and all four hashes were unchanged after my runs.
- **R12-3 (gate): PASS.** From a clean state the full `verifyCommand` exited 0:
  - Biome: 0 errors, 9 warnings (same as on `35ed18b`).
  - Typecheck: 0 errors.
  - Tests: renderer 112/112, main 62/62, E2E 7/7.
  - A separate E2E run with `--retries=0` also passed 7/7.
- **R12-4 (no workaround on `.claude/**`): PASS.** `permission_denials` is empty in A's result. A's report says the change was made with the Edit tool (path b), and the diff is exactly the one patch. One limit: A's result file doesn't list individual tool calls. So "no Bash write to `.claude/**`" rests on the empty denials, A's report and the exact diff, not on a full transcript.

The task didn't require re-driving the real app, but I reran round 11's driver script on the new build as a smoke test, in Electron under xvfb at 1400×900:
- **Partial failure:** the app showed "1 saved, 1 failed", the typed value stayed and Save stayed enabled. The file that saved holds the new category value, read back with both ffprobe and music-metadata. The file that failed was unchanged.
- **Retry:** the app reported "Tags saved to 2 files" and both files then held the value. This confirms the new docs line, "retry writes to all selected files".
- **Other save paths:** saving several files that all succeed, saving a single file, saving after applying a template, and closing the folder behaved as in round 11.

Windows packaging isn't part of this round and can't run here.
